Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let la: LoanAgreement in
		la.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = la and
		la.Content = "Loan Agreement" and
		result = true
}
